challenges.code:
# Step 1: Switch to main and pull latest
# git checkout main
# git pull origin main

# Step 2: Create feature branch
# git checkout -b feature/add-login

# Step 3: Make changes and commit
# git add .
# git commit -m "feat(auth): add login endpoint"

# Step 4: Push to remote
# git push -u origin feature/add-login

# Step 5: After PR is merged, clean up
# git checkout main
# git pull origin main
# git branch -d feature/add-login

print("Complete Git workflow from branch creation to cleanup")
challenges.verified_output: Complete Git workflow from branch creation to cleanup
